question: May LYB send a push or other outbound message to request a photo, weigh-in, or check-in?
decision: No outbound asks this release for a photo, weigh-in, or check-in, through push notifications or any other outbound channel.
cadence_semantics: 0 denotes no permitted outbound cadence while outbound asks are disabled. Future enablement requires a separate decision defining a permitted cadence.
in_app_policy: Show at most one in-app single-card ask when the value policy marks it useful. Eligibility and selection remain with the ranker.
boundaries: Decision record only. This slice adds no notification sender, scheduling, delivery integration, or runtime ranker changes. It does not change unrelated notifications or reminders.
